channel.title: The Rambam on Pirkei Avot — Dayan Daniel Kada
channel.description: Dayan Daniel Kada's Tuesday-night series on the Rambam's commentary to Pirkei Avot, May to July 2024: the chain of tradition, friendship, the reward of misvot, humility, and whether a rabbi may be paid for teaching Torah.
channel.itunes:author: Dayan Daniel Kada

item.title: Why Does the Mishnah Say Acquire a Friend? | The Rambam on Pirkei Avot, Chapter 1
item.description:
How does the Rambam read the opening Mishnayot of Avot? Torah, avodah and gemilut hasadim as intellectual perfection, misvot and character; serving HaShem without expecting reward; making a teacher and acquiring a friend; judging favourably; and the Rambam's five categories of speech.

item.title: Why the Torah Hides the Reward of Each Misvah | The Rambam on Pirkei Avot, Chapter 2
item.description:
Why are the rewards of the misvot kept hidden? The Rambam's commentary to Chapter 2 of Pirkei Avot, read through his Shemonah Perakim: the middle path of Tiferet, eight levels of prohibition, character lessons in the Mishnayot, and why Torah study comes first.

item.title: Why a Thousand Small Gifts Beat One Big One | The Rambam on Pirkei Avot, Chapter 3
item.description:
Is one grand gesture worth more than many small ones? Rambam's commentary on Pirkei Avot chapter 3: remembering origin, destiny and reckoning, prayer for the government, the Shekhinah among those who learn, good habits before ethics study, and character shaped by the majority of deeds.

item.title: Why Humility Is the One Trait With No Middle Path | The Rambam on Pirkei Avot, Chapter 4, Part 1
item.description:
Every trait has a golden mean except one. Chapter 4 of Pirkei Avot opens with Ben Zoma's definitions of the wise, strong, wealthy and honoured; the class covers reward for a misvah, lowness of spirit as freedom from ego, and the Rambam's ruling like Rav Nahman.

item.title: May a Rabbi Take a Salary for Teaching Torah? | The Rambam on Pirkei Avot, Chapter 4, Part 2
item.description:
Is living off Torah study ever acceptable? The Rambam reads the Mishnah's warning about using Torah as a spade as a ban on scholars drawing a livelihood from it. The class weighs the Tashbes, the Kesef Mishneh and the Shulhan Arukh, and the Rabbi's view on kolel.

item.title: Which of the Rambam's Five Kinds of People Are You? | The Rambam on Pirkei Avot, Chapter 5
item.description:
The last class before the summer break covers the chapter's tens and the Rambam's view that miracles were built into nature, then his five kinds of people (bur, am haares, golem, hakham, hasid), the seven marks of the wise, why extremes differ, love that lasts and the students of Avraham and Bilam.
